Each sandwich contains two of the three ingredients, so every customer's meal contains at least one of the pairs (ham–cheese, ham–tomato, tomato–cheese). Counting customers therefore means counting those whose meals contain at least one pair.

Customers whose meals contain exactly two ingredients:
- Ham and cheese only: 80 − 20 = 60
- Ham and tomato only: 90 − 20 = 70
- Tomato and cheese only: 100 − 20 = 80

Customers whose meals contain all three: 20

Total = 60 + 70 + 80 + 20 = 230

ANSWER: 230
